feature_definition: Log probabilities over the same ten score-token bins, 0 through 9, in the basic monitoring prompt. No hidden-coordinate correspondence is supplied.
scope: A public-output observer transferred between existing checkpoints on identical APPS rows. Not a self-improved model, not internal-mechanism transfer, and not fresh inference. Previously stored outcomes informed the broad question. Calibration subsets and all fitting choices are fixed before this transfer run; all budgets and seeds are reported. Positive affine recalibration cannot change a top-budget ranking and is a mathematical no-change control.
